turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Owen's essay. Who decided on the zero?
Before anything else: I entered the zero before I called you. That broke procedure 4.2, and I am sorry.
Okay. Was Owen heard before you entered it?
Here is the version history. Created Wednesday, October 28, 11:31 PM, title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words in one edit. At 11:58 PM, 794 more. No earlier drafts. Read it yourself.
I'm writing those times down. Pasting in a draft from somewhere else isn't a crime. And you still haven't told me whether Owen was heard before that zero went in.
If he drafted somewhere else, that file has its own dates. Bring it and I will look at it with you.
Fine. Your own procedure says you speak to the student first, and nobody has told me that happened. Whatever comes of this, Hale, it stays off his record and it stays quiet.
Second: the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile. It is not in Hamlet. Search the play yourself.
Seventeen-year-olds misquote Shakespeare all the time. A bad quotation proves he got a line wrong, nothing more.

You mentioned his December 1 deadline. Under 4.4 he can do a supervised rewrite this Thursday, private, in my room. I will mark it by Monday, so the new mark replaces the zero before December 1, and nothing goes on his record. I will put the dates in writing tonight.

I never mentioned a deadline, but it's the one that matters. To put this behind him, Owen sits the rewrite Thursday, alone in your room. Tonight's email says the new mark replaces the zero by Monday and nothing goes on his record, ever.
He'll be there. Send the email.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed that Owen will sit a private supervised rewrite this Thursday in your room, that you will mark it by Monday, and that its mark replaces the zero with nothing placed on his record. I still require all of that in writing, along with a clear statement of whether Owen was spoken to before the zero was entered. I expect the dates in writing tonight, as you said.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She reached her last position and agreed to a private supervised rewrite on Thursday, marked by Monday, replacing the zero with nothing on his record, and she still wants all of it confirmed in writing tonight; that is the fair outcome under procedure 4.4, reached before her time ran out.
What moved her: You showed the version history with exact times and dates from Owen's own file and told her to read it herself, then answered her pasting defence by pointing to a draft file she could bring, which left her nothing to push back with.
What cost ground: You never answered her question about whether Owen was spoken to before the zero, which left her a procedural complaint to carry to the principal even after she agreed.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history landed on the night of Wednesday, October 28, just before midnight, about as close to that night as your evidence could come; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she first asked whether Owen was heard before you entered the zero, answer it plainly in one sentence before showing the version history, so the only open question left is the essay itself.
